_comment: #348 property table (spec docs/design/2026-08-02-emergent-skill-interactions-spec.md); resolved in WIFieldSkills.dispatch, policed by data_lint. ROW ORDER IS THE CONTRACT (first match wins): a frozen water cell carries BOTH `frozen` and `freezable`, so thaw must precede the water refusal. state_set banks the CARRIER's `counter_key`, never a row id.

interactions._comment: counter_from=target (#398-p2 review HIGH-1): a burnable may name its OWN counter in `burn_counter`; carriers that author none keep banking the row's `burned_the_debris`. One row over every burnable in the game cannot also be one world event.
interactions.toast_default: Flame takes the debris. It crackles, collapses to ash, and the way is clear.
Frost races across the water and locks it solid. You can cross now. Until it thaws.

interactions._comment: MUST precede the burns x freezable refusal below -- a frozen cell is still a freezable one.
interactions.toast_default: [Firefly] — You hold the flame low over the ice. It sags, greys, then drops away into black water. The channel runs open again.
[Firefly] — The flame gutters the moment it nears the water. Steam ghosts off the surface and the channel takes it back. Fire has nothing to hold here.
[Firefly] — The flame catches and the hearth takes it. Warmth climbs the stone.
[Firefly] — The wick takes the flame and holds it. Light spreads out from the glass.
[Light] — A steady orb settles into the glass and stays lit.
[Basic Cleaning] — The grime lifts away and the surface comes up clean.

interactions._comment: The douse cell. No reversal substrate in v1 (spec §4.1), so the refusal IS the answer. toast_from=skill: `freezes` has two carriers; a row line naming one lies about the other.
interactions.toast_default: [Snap Freeze] — Frost crawls onto the hot stone and vanishes before it can settle. The fire goes on eating. Your cold has no purchase on it.
[Snap Freeze] — The cold gathers in your palm and stops there. You are pointing a killing frost at someone who has done nothing to you. Your hand comes down.

interactions._comment: state_set on a `broken` carrier: one-way, save-persisted, a traversal seam the world keeps open. toast_from=target because _outcome_state_set passes an EMPTY skill dict -- a state_set row can never read the caster.
interactions.toast_default: [Basic Repair] — You put the break back the way it was meant to sit. It holds.

interactions._comment: The traversal pair's other half; same permanence class as the repair row.
interactions.toast_default: [Rope Work] — You make the line fast and set it taut across. The crossing stays a crossing.
Steel cuts through the growth. The way is clear.
